subject: The 3AM workflow of our top 1%
preview_text: See how power users turn 3AM spirals into healing breakthroughs—and how you can too.
body_paragraphs: Remember the last time you woke up at 3AM, heart racing, replaying that one memory? It's the worst. But here's something wild: our top 1% of users don't just survive those moments—they weaponize them. They've found a workflow that turns panic into progress, and I'm about to share it with you.

Here's the secret: they don't fight the spiral. They lean into it. Instead of scrolling their ex's profile or lying there stuck, they open the app and hit Emergency Mode. It's not just about calming down—it's a structured process. They do a 2-minute breathing exercise, then a guided journal prompt that forces them to name one thing they're grateful for from the relationship. Not the person—the lesson. Then they log the mood shift. It sounds simple, but the data shows these users heal 40% faster because they're not avoiding the pain; they're processing it in real time.

That workflow—Emergency Mode, a specific journal prompt, then mood tracking—is something you can set up right now. It's already built into the app, but most users never connect the dots. See, the top 1% customize their Coping Strategies based on their breakup type. Yours is likely 'slow fade' or 'betrayal'—the app tailors the prompts to that. Once you set it up, the 3AM moments won't own you anymore. You'll own them.

Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy now, go to your Coping Strategies, and choose '3AM Spiral Protocol' as your default. That's it. One tap, and you're in the club. P.S. The next time you're up at 3AM, don't fight it. Just open the app and let the workflow carry you. You'll be back to sleep in 10 minutes—I've seen it happen 600 times.
